case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests repeatedly praised the hotel's central location, renovated/modern rooms, cleanliness, comfortable beds and friendly, helpful staff. Recurring negatives included noise from the street or staff and mixed comments about breakfast (not included, limited options, desire for fresh orange juice). Isolated issues mentioned by individual guests included missed room cleaning, lack of a fridge or blinds, some dirt on the floor, water pressure and shower-screen splash.
